text: This chapter completes the 3-part 4ths Close & Spread material in C Harmonic Minor across all 6 cycles. The 4-way close voice-leading map (7 → 2nd, 4 → c.t., 3 → c.t., 1 → 2nd intervallic; 7 → 3, 4 → 1, 3 → 7, 1 → 4 functional) is the core rule for Cycle 4. Drop 2 & 4 voice-leading shows specific directional behavior. Cycle 6 introduces a different functional resolution pattern from Cycle 4. The pivot to C Harmonic Minor in Cycle 2 introduces a 3rd intervallic leap for voice 7, distinguishing harmonic minor voice-leading from melodic minor's predominantly stepwise motion.
